title: Classic Italian Pasta Fettuccine
description: A simple yet flavorful pasta dish originating from Italy. Enjoy the comforting taste of fettuccine in a rich and creamy sauce.
instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions.
2. In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
3. Add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
4. Pour in heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
5. Reduce heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 2-3 minutes.
6. Stir in Parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
7. Season the sauce with salt to taste.
8. Drain the cooked fettuccine pasta and add it to the sauce.
9. Toss the pasta in the creamy sauce until well coated.
10. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
